articles.title: Elon Musk says record spending on US midterms was 'pretty foolish'
articles.summary: The multi-billionaire also said he was "not Maga", distancing himself from the political movement linked to Trump.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Elon Musk says record spending on US midterms was 'pretty foolish'
articles.summaryTr: The multi-billionaire also said he was "not Maga", distancing himself from the political movement linked to Trump.
articles.articleText: Elon Musk says record spending on US midterms was 'pretty foolish' - Published Elon Musk said on Wednesday that he felt "pretty foolish" about the record sum he spent on the US midterm elections, following sweeping Republican defeats. The Tesla and SpaceX CEO was the election's top individual donor, giving $446m (£339m) to support President Donald Trump's party, particularly in Texas where many of Musk's firms are based. Musk, who had backed Trump's second White House bid, also said he was "not Maga" - the Make America Great Again movement associated with the president. Democrats won control of the both chambers in the US Congress, flipping both swing seats and making historic gains in places that have for decades been controlled by Republicans. The election was seen as a bruising defeat for Trump, who has faced pressure over the impact his policies have had on the cost of living in the US. Musk was speaking virtually, external at the New York Times DealBook Summit, an annual conference hosted in the city attended by major business and political leaders. "I'm not Maga," Musk said, referring to the right-wing political movement. He added: "I'm not sure what Maga means... if that means sort of blind adherence to a set of policies by the Republican Party, then I certainly don't have that." Musk went on to say he did not see much for the money he had spent on the Republicans' campaign, though he added that it was likely that candidates would have fared worse without the spending. The large number of Republican losses could have implications for Musk and his businesses. Democrats coming into power in both the Senate and House of Representatives have pledged greater scrutiny of tech companies, including over the building of controversial data centres. In Georgia, where SpaceX has data centre operations, the newly elected Democrat governor promised to limit the rollout of the massive buildings, as well as the tax breaks tech companies often get to build them. Democratic lawmakers have also suggested that SpaceX, which has gained an estimated $10bn in new government contracts since Trump was re-elected, should be investigated. One of the most striking midterms wins went to Democrat James Talarico, who beat Republican Ken Paxton for a US Senate seat in Texas. According to BBC analysis, Musk had spent at least $45m in support of Paxton. Texas is where key operations for Musk's car company Tesla and rocket and technology firm SpaceX are based. Musk said on Wednesday that he believes Texas' new governor, Democrat Gina Hinojosa, is "going to be quite moderate". Hinojosa defeated Republican Governor Greg Abbott, ending more than three decades of the party's control of the state. The Tesla boss added : "I don't think she's a far-left governor. And based on everything I've heard about her, I think things will be fine in Texas with Gina as governor." - Published5 November - Published4 November

articles.titleTr: Claude-maker Anthropic poised for stock market debut worth up to $1.5tn
articles.summaryTr: Anthropic started just five years ago an is now one of the biggest names in artificial intelligence.
articles.articleText: Claude-maker Anthropic poised for stock market debut worth up to $1.5tn - Published Anthropic is poised to hit a value of up to $1.5tn (£1.14tn) when its shares start trading on the stock market on Thursday. The artificial intelligence (AI) company behind the popular chatbot Claude said its shares will be priced at $83 each when it lists on the Nasdaq, a tech-focused stock exchange based in New York. That price will make it one of the most highly valued companies in the world. It will be the first US firm focused exclusively on AI to go public, marking a crucial test for the fast-growing industry, which faces questions over whether the huge investment poured into the technology will be profitable. The AI firm said earlier this month it would likely offer its shares for between $70 and $78 each, which valued the company at up to $1.3tn. But demand for Anthropic's stock debut - commonly referred to as its initial public offering, or IPO - is very high, according to one early investor in the company who spoke with the BBC on condition of anonymity. The person said shares were more than 10 times oversubscribed ahead of the public listing, meaning demand for Anthropic shares exceeded the number of shares available. If that turns out to be the case, Anthropic's valuation could quickly blow past its target on Thursday when trading begins. Crucial test for AI Depending on how strong that demand is, Anthropic could even exceed the early market valuation of Elon Musk's SpaceX, which was the world's most highly valued stock debut when it went public with a value of $2.2tn in June. However, in the weeks that followed, SpaceX shares fell significantly in price. As it stands, Anthropic's listing will see the firm raise more than $68bn from its initial investors. It is also expecting another $26bn from private placements. So the total amount the company will raise is expected to be $94bn. The amount of cash Anthropic has raised from its listing is already more than SpaceX raised in June. OpenAI, the maker of ChatGPT and Anthropic's biggest AI rival, is expected to go public next year. Until then, Anthropic will be the only public company in the US that is entirely focused on the technology, or one that was founded and built around AI tools and products. Its scope is different from tech giants like Google and Microsoft that also develop AI but are involved in other tech services. - The seven Anthropic founders who are about to become multi-billionaires - Published3 hours ago There is excitement around Anthropic's listing, but also some concern from investors around its ability to generate revenue and profits going forward. Yang Wang, a principle financial analyst with Counterpoint Research, said the central issue for Anthropic is whether its business "can keep pace" as hundreds of billions of dollars in financial obligations come due in the next couple of years. "Nevertheless, it is not an everyday occurrence for public investors to gain direct exposure to a frontier-model developer with the potential to shape the next stage of productivity," Wang said. While nearly every other major tech company is pouring huge amounts of money into the technology and infrastructure required for their own AI tools, they are built around social media or online retail or online search. AI tools and applications are secondary. "Anthropic going public gives us a whole new window into what AI demand looks like," Marta Norton, who heads strategy at investment firm Empower, told the BBC. Rapid rise Anthropic was started by a group of co-founders, led by siblings Dario Amodei and Daniela Amodei, all of whom left their work at OpenAI to start a new AI firm. The company has carved itself out in the ongoing AI race as more focused on building the technology with safety top of mind. It refused to comply with a demand by the US Department of Defense that Anthropic's tools be used in an essentially unrestricted way. CEO Dario Amodei has been outspoken in his belief that AI tools may soon be so powerful that they present a threat to human existence. The company has urged developers to slow the development of AI, arguing that advanced systems could pose "catastrophic" risks to humanity if they are not handled with appropriate safeguards. Rival firm OpenAI has also voiced similar concerns about the technology's risks and delayed its plans to list on the stock market to address AI safety concerns. Nonetheless, Anthropic is looking to grow quickly and gain more access to financing through the public markets in order to do so. Norton said Anthropic going public now, in a time of market volatility comes down to the simple fact that the company needs access to more money. "AI is financially demanding," Norton said. "The public markets open up the financial spigot a little bit more, and so the time has come." But broader anxieties have started to grow about the AI industry's business model, which is reliant on expensive computer chips that are in short supply. The technology is also dependent on controversial data centres and funding such operations require deals with other tech companies. The Federal Reserve Bank has expressed concern about the rapid growth of AI-related debt being financed through "complex and opaque" structures, according to minutes from its October meeting to discuss a potential rate rise. A few of the meeting's participants also noted that "AI-related exposures were becoming increasingly concentrated among a small number of firms". With additional reporting by Rachel Clun and Osmond Chia Related topics - Published5 hours ago - Published20 hours ago

articles.summary: Americans reported more than $17.7 billion in online fraud losses in 2025.

articles.titleTr: Trump administration unveils new center to choke off scam payments
articles.summaryTr: Americans reported more than $17.7 billion in online fraud losses in 2025.
articles.articleText: Trump administration unveils new center to choke off scam payments Americans reported more than $17.7 billion in online fraud losses in 2025. The Trump administration has unveiled a new Threat Disruption Center, aimed at stopping money flows to foreign criminal networks behind scams, cybercrime and sextortion schemes. The Homeland Security Task Force’s National Coordination Center, co-led by the departments of Homeland Security and Justice, announced the launch of the unit on Wednesday. It seeks to help more than 30 federal agencies and over 440 state and local partners track scams and work with banks and crypto platforms to stop payments to scam networks. The Homeland Security statement said the center was created under a March 2026 executive order that directed federal agencies to work with private companies to combat online fraud and other cybercrime targeting Americans. “Every hour between a victim’s report and a response gives criminals more time to launder stolen funds and identify their next target,” said Heith Janke, operations director of the FBI’s Criminal Branch. Blockchain intelligence firm TRM Labs was selected as the center’s main private-sector partner. It will provide and maintain Ardence, the investigative platform the center will use to map scam networks and identify victims. TRM said it will also provide engineering and investigative support. “These scammers rarely stop after one payment — they drain a victim’s savings, or their retirement, over months and years,” said Esteban Castano, co-founder and CEO of TRM Labs. “Stepping in sooner changes everything: a warning before the next payment, a scam website removed before it victimizes another family, or stolen funds frozen while they can still be recovered. The FBI received about 453,000 reports of online fraud in 2025, with reported losses exceeding $17.7 billion. In September, the Justice Department estimated that overseas scam centers cost Americans about $10 billion a year through schemes including crypto and online investment fraud. Related: US authorities dismantle crypto scam network that stole tens of millions

articles.summaryTr: The head of Crimea said traffic was suspended after another attack on the link between Russia and the occupied territory.
articles.articleText: Crimean Bridge attacked again, Russian official says - Published The Crimean Bridge has been attacked by Ukraine for the third time this week, a Russian official has said. The Moscow-installed head of Crimea, Sergei Aksyonov, confirmed that traffic was temporarily suspended following another strike on the bridge connecting Russia to occupied Crimea. The critical bridge had already been hit twice earlier in the week resulting in severe damage and part of the bridge collapsing into the water. The important infrastructure has long been targeted by Ukraine because of its significance as a logistical and symbolic asset to Moscow's war effort. It comes as Russian President Vladimir Putin meets US President Donald Trump and China's President Xi Jinping on Thursday for landmark talks in China. articles.title: Van Gogh painting sells for record $190.4m after row over its Nazi history
articles.summary: Châtaigniers en fleurs was painted in 1890 in the final two months of Vincent van Gogh's life.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Van Gogh painting sells for record $190.4m after row over its Nazi history
articles.summaryTr: Châtaigniers en fleurs was painted in 1890 in the final two months of Vincent van Gogh's life.
articles.articleText: Van Gogh painting sells for record $190.4m after row over its Nazi history - Published Auction house Sotheby's has sold a painting by Vincent van Gogh for a record $190.4m (£144.8m). The sale of Châtaigniers en fleurs ("Chestnut Trees in Blossom") shatters the renowned artist's previous auction record of $117.2 million set in 2022. The historic sale in New York on Wednesday comes after an eleventh-hour agreement was reached to resolve a dispute regarding claims the art piece was previously sold under duress during the rise of the Nazis. Châtaigniers en fleurs was painted in 1890 in the final two months of Van Gogh's life. It is considered one of the most important works of art from that period to remain in private hands, according to Sotheby's. It was not immediately clear who purchased the painting. The BBC has contacted Sotheby's for comment. The oil painting, which was estimated to carry a value of $180m (£136m) prior to the sale, was put up for auction as part of a set called the Blaquier-Arrieta Collection. Sotheby's announced in the hours before the auction that it had resolved a dispute between the Blaquier-Arrieta family and the heirs of the Fischer family - the prior German owners of the work - regarding the sale. Representatives acting for heirs of the Fischer family had claimed the painting may have been sold under duress during the rise of the Nazis. A lawyer for the family's heirs reportedly wrote to Sotheby's on their behalf, telling the auction house that the painting was sold in Amsterdam before World War Two because of financial losses the Fischer family's publishing company suffered under the Nazis. The BBC has contacted the lawyer for comment. "In recognition of the painting's complex Nazi-era history and the suffering endured by the Fischer family during the Holocaust, the two families have reached a mutually satisfactory resolution and the work will be sold pursuant to their agreement," Sotheby's said on Wednesday. Sotheby's website details the provenance of the oil painting and how it has researched the artwork changing hands since 1890. It says Samuel Fischer - a famous German publisher - acquired it 1909 before it was passed down in his family after his death in 1934. The painting was deposited with Paul Cassirer in Amsterdam in 1932 or 1933 before it went to Henriette and Marcel Kapferer in Paris in 1936, Sotheby's said. Four other owners then had the painting. The Blaquier family acquired it in 1975 and owned it for more than half a century before the latest sale, the auction house said.

articles.title: Fed officials saw October rate hold as a ‘close call,’ minutes show
articles.summary: The latest FOMC minutes suggest greater appetite for higher rates than the Fed’s 10–2 vote indicated, with markets now pricing in a December hike.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Fed officials saw October rate hold as a ‘close call,’ minutes show
articles.summaryTr: The latest FOMC minutes suggest greater appetite for higher rates than the Fed’s 10–2 vote indicated, with markets now pricing in a December hike.
articles.articleText: Fed officials saw October rate hold as a ‘close call,’ minutes show The latest FOMC minutes suggest greater appetite for higher rates than the Fed’s 10–2 vote indicated, with markets now pricing in a December hike. A few Federal Reserve officials who supported holding interest rates steady in October considered the decision a “close call,” according to minutes released Wednesday, as policymakers signaled that further hikes would likely be needed to bring inflation back to 2%. The Federal Open Market Committee voted 10–2 in October to keep its benchmark rate at 3.75% to 4%. Fed Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack favored a quarter-point increase. The minutes showed that a few participants who supported holding rates steady still viewed the decision as a “close call.” “The minutes suggest broader support for an October hike than the 10–2 vote alone implied — and that was before payrolls and CPI both came in hot,” Lewis Huang, an analyst at crypto exchange Bitget, told Cointelegraph. With markets overwhelmingly expecting a December rate hike, attention is shifting to whether the Fed will raise rates by a quarter or half percentage point. “With a December hike already fully priced in, the focus shifts to the size of the move and the policy path beyond December,” said Huang. CME FedWatch has put the odds of a December quarter-point hike at about 90% and a half-point increase at about 10% at the time of writing. Bitcoin was trading around $62,300 after the minutes were released. Huang said a further rise in Treasury yields and the dollar would add pressure to Bitcoin, which was already trading below its 200-week moving average near $68,000. “For Bitcoin, a break below the weekend low near $62,000 could extend the sell-off,” Huang said. Fed officials flag AI inflation and financial stability risks Fed officials also raised concerns about the inflationary impact of AI investment, with many participants noting that demand for related equipment was straining supply and pushing up consumer technology prices. Several warned that the pressures were spreading beyond industries directly involved in data center construction. Related: Hot US inflation raises odds of half-point Fed hike in December Officials separately discussed the financial risks if AI investments disappointed. “Most participants observed that AI-related debt had grown rapidly and that much of this growth had taken place through complex and opaque financing structures,” the minutes show. “A few participants remarked that AI-related exposures were becoming increasingly concentrated among a small number of firms.” Fabian Dori, chief investment officer at Sygnum Bank, said markets were already pricing in a series of hikes into next year. “That likely keeps long-term yields and the dollar firm, and the question for Bitcoin is whether debasement concerns and advancing institutional adoption can outweigh it,” Dori said. Magazine: How to preserve wealth and access funds during a national emergency

articles.titleTr: CNBC-E ÖZEL! Borsa soruşturmasında 108 kişi için kritik karar: Hesapların dondurulması istendi
articles.summaryTr: İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı, borsa manipülasyonu soruşturmasında 108 kişinin malvarlığının takibe alınmasını istedi. Bazı hisselerde 100 kata varan yükselişlerin tespit edildiği soruşturmada, şüphelilerin sermaye piyasası araçlarının dondurulması talep edildi.
articles.articleText: CNBC-E ÖZEL! Borsa soruşturmasında 108 kişi için kritik karar: Hesapların dondurulması istendi - İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı, borsada manipülasyon ve suç gelirlerinin aklanması soruşturması kapsamında 108 kişinin malvarlığı hareketlerinin takibe alınmasını istedi. Bazı hisselerde 100 kata varan yükselişlere dikkat çekilen yazıda, şüphelilerin sermaye piyasası araçlarının dondurulması talep edildi. Türkiye Sermaye Piyasaları Birliği’nin (TSPB) üyelerine ve kripto varlık hizmet sağlayıcı kuruluşlara gönderdiği yazıya göre, İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı, Borsa İstanbul’da işlem gören hisselerde manipülasyon ve suç gelirlerinin aklanması iddialarına ilişkin soruşturmada 108 kişiyi kapsayan yeni bir adım attı. Başsavcılık, bazı hisselerde 100 kata varan fiyat artışlarına dikkat çekerek ilgili kişilerin sermaye piyasası araçlarının dondurulmasını ve olağan dışı malvarlığı işlemlerinin savcılık denetimine tabi tutulmasını istedi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Türkiye Sermaye Piyasaları Birliği’nin (TSPB) üyelerine ve kripto varlık hizmet sağlayıcı kuruluşlara ilettiği yazıda, İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı tarafından yürütülen borsa manipülasyonu ve kara para aklama soruşturması kapsamında alınması istenen tedbirlere yer verildi. TSPB tarafından iletilen, Başsavcılığın 18 Kasım 2026 tarihli yazısında, nitelikli dolandırıcılık ve Sermaye Piyasası Kanunu’na muhalefet suçlarından elde edildiği değerlendirilen gelirlerin aklanmasına ilişkin yürütülen soruşturma kapsamında 108 kişinin malvarlığı işlemlerinin yakından takip edilmesi istendi. Bazı hisselerde 100 kata varan yükseliş tespit edildi Başsavcılığın yazısında, Borsa İstanbul’da işlem gören bazı hisselerde manipülatif işlemlerin portföy yönetim sektörü ve yatırım fonları üzerinden gerçekleştirildiğine ilişkin ihbarların bulunduğu belirtildi. Savcılık tarafından yapılan incelemelerde, bazı hisselerin değerinde yaklaşık 100 kata varan artışlar meydana geldiği ve bu fiyat hareketlerinin şirketlerin faaliyetleriyle açıklanamayacak nitelikte olduğunun değerlendirildiği kaydedildi. Soruşturma kapsamında, hisselerin önemli bölümünün yatırım fonları aracılığıyla toplandığı, gerçekleştirilen alımların hem ilgili şirketlerin hisse fiyatlarını hem de bu hisseleri portföyünde bulunduran fonların değerlerini yükselttiği ifade edildi. Savcılık, yapay fiyat artışları yoluyla ciddi miktarda menfaat sağlandığı ve elde edilen suç gelirlerinin farklı yatırım ve ticari faaliyetler üzerinden katmanlaştırılarak kaynağından uzaklaştırıldığı yönünde kuvvetli suç şüphesi oluştuğunu bildirdi. 108 kişinin 100 milyon lirayı aşan bireysel kârları mercek altında Başsavcılığın yazısında dikkat çeken bir diğer tespit ise manipülasyon şüphesi bulunan dönemlerde elde edilen yüksek tutarlı kazançlar oldu. Yapılan incelemelerde, Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu’nun (SPK) suç duyurusuna konu hisselerinde yüksek hacimli işlemleri bulunan ve manipülasyon tespit edilen dönemlerde bireysel kârları 100 milyon lirayı aşan 108 şüpheli hakkında işlem yapılmadığının belirlendiği aktarıldı. Bu tespit üzerine Başsavcılık, ilgili kişilerin malvarlığı hareketlerinin kontrol altına alınması amacıyla bankalar, sermaye piyasası kuruluşları ve diğer ilgili kurumlara talepler içeren bir yazı gönderdi. Sermaye piyasası araçlarının dondurulması istendi TSPB aracılığıyla ilgili kuruluşlara iletilen savcılık yazısında, kimlik bilgilerine yer verilen 108 kişinin hesaplarında bulunan sermaye piyasası araçlarının, soruşturmanın kapsamı ve isnat edilen suçlar dikkate alınarak ilgili kuruluşlarca dondurulması istendi. Ayrıca söz konusu kişilerin malvarlıklarına ilişkin devir, satış, bağış, temlik, ipotek ve rehin işlemleri ile yüksek tutarlı nakit çekimi, EFT ve havale gibi işlemlerinin yakından takip edilmesi talep edildi. articles.titleTr: İstanbul'da suya aylık zam uygulaması 2027'de de sürecek: Artışa yüzde 2 sınırı
articles.summaryTr: İSKİ Genel Kurulu'nda kabul edilen kararla İstanbul'da su tarifelerine her ay TÜFE ve Yİ-ÜFE ortalamasına göre zam yapılması uygulaması 2027'de de devam edecek. Hesaplanan artış yüzde 2'yi aşarsa zam oranı yüzde 2 ile sınırlandırılacak.
articles.articleText: İstanbul'da suya aylık zam uygulaması 2027'de de sürecek: Artışa yüzde 2 sınırı - İSKİ Genel Kurulu'nda kabul edilen kararla İstanbul'da su tarifelerine her ay TÜFE ve Yİ-ÜFE ortalamasına göre zam yapılması uygulaması 2027'de de devam edecek. Hesaplanan artış yüzde 2'yi aşarsa zam oranı yüzde 2 ile sınırlandırılacak. İstanbul'da su tarifelerine her ay otomatik zam yapılmasını öngören uygulamanın 2027 yılında da sürdürülmesi kararlaştırıldı. İstanbul Su ve Kanalizasyon İdaresi (İSKİ) Genel Kurulu'nda kabul edilen teklife göre, aylık zam oranı yüzde 2'yi aşamayacak. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle İBB Meclisi kasım ayı toplantılarının dördüncü oturumunda yapılan İSKİ Genel Kurulu'nda, su satış ve kullanılmış suyun uzaklaştırılması bedellerine ilişkin tarife teklifi görüşüldü. Zam hesabında TÜFE ve Yİ-ÜFE ortalaması kullanılacak İBB Meclisi'nin 20 Kasım 2024 tarihli kararıyla uygulamaya alınan sistem kapsamında su tarifelerine, Tüketici Fiyat Endeksi (TÜFE) ile Yurt İçi Üretici Fiyat Endeksi'nin (Yİ-ÜFE) toplanıp ikiye bölünmesiyle elde edilen oran üzerinden aylık zam yapılıyor. Genel Kurul'da kabul edilen yeni düzenlemeyle bu uygulama, 1 Ocak 2027'den itibaren yeni bir karar alınana kadar devam edecek. Ancak hesaplanan zam oranı yüzde 2'nin üzerinde çıkarsa artış yüzde 2 ile sınırlandırılacak. Oranın yüzde 2'nin altında kalması halinde ise hesaplanan oran uygulanacak. Otomatik zam uygulamasının kaldırılması teklifi reddedildi AK Parti Grup Sözcüsü Murat Türkyılmaz, suya her ay otomatik zam yapılmasına tepki göstererek uygulamanın sona erdirilmesini isteyen bir aykırı teklif sunduklarını açıkladı. Ancak bu teklif Meclis'te yapılan oylamada reddedildi. DEM Parti Grup Sözcüsü Suat Karaoğlan ise TÜFE ve Yİ-ÜFE ortalamasının yüzde 2'nin altında kalması halinde hesaplanan oranın, üzerinde olması durumunda ise en fazla yüzde 2 zam uygulanmasını önerdi. AK Parti, CHP ve Yeni Parti bu teklife destek vereceklerini, BBP ise karşı çıkacağını bildirdi. Yapılan oylamada yüzde 2'lik üst sınır getiren teklif oy çokluğuyla kabul edildi. Yeni uygulama 1 Ocak 2027'de başlayacak.

Bazı üyeler, aralık ayında 25 baz puanın üzerinde artışın değerlendirilebileceğini belirtti. ABD Merkez Bankası'nın (Fed) 27-28 Ekim tarihlerinde gerçekleştirdiği toplantının tutanakları, para politikasına ilişkin görüş ayrılıklarını ortaya koydu. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Tutanaklara göre katılımcıların çoğu, ekim toplantısında faiz oranlarının sabit tutulmasını destekledi. Ancak bazı üyeler, enflasyonun hâlâ yüksek olduğuna ve gerileme işaretlerinin sınırlı kaldığına dikkat çekerek 25 baz puanlık faiz artışından yana görüş bildirdi. Aralık ayında daha büyük faiz artışı ihtimali Tutanaklarda öne çıkan başlıklardan biri de aralık ayındaki toplantıya ilişkin değerlendirmeler oldu. Birkaç Fed yetkilisi, açıklanacak enflasyon verilerinin beklentilerin üzerinde gelmesi halinde aralık toplantısında 25 baz puanın üzerinde bir faiz artışının değerlendirilmesinin gerekebileceğini ifade etti. Bazı katılımcılar, enflasyonun beklenenden daha kalıcı olabileceğini ve bunun para politikasında daha sıkı bir duruşa geçilmesini gerektirebileceğini belirtti. Faizlerin sabit tutulmasını destekleyen bazı üyeler ise bu kararın kolay alınmadığını, kararın sınırda olduğunu vurguladı. Faiz artışından yana olan birkaç yetkili de piyasalara daha fazla sıkılaşmanın olası olduğunun açık biçimde anlatılması halinde faizlerin değiştirilmemesini destekleyebileceklerini kaydetti. Enflasyonla mücadele mesajı vurgulandı Tutanaklara göre çok sayıda katılımcı, faiz artırmama kararının Fed'in enflasyonu zamanında yüzde 2 hedefine döndürme konusundaki kararlılığının zayıfladığı şeklinde yorumlanmaması gerektiğini vurguladı. Yapay zekâ yatırımları da gündemdeydi Toplantıda yapay zekâ yatırımlarındaki büyüme de kapsamlı biçimde ele alındı. Katılımcılar, yapay zekâ yatırımlarının finansal istikrar üzerindeki olası etkilerini ve verimlilik artışı potansiyelini değerlendirdi.

articles.titleTr: İSKİ'den yeni yıl zammı: Su açma-kapama bedeli arttı! İşte yeni fiyat
articles.summaryTr: İSKİ'nin 2027 yılı hizmet bedeli tarifesi kabul edildi. Su açma-kapama ücreti yüzde 19,72 artışla 607 liraya, vidanjör hizmeti bedeli ise yüzde 40,18 zamla 2 bin 533 liraya çıktı. Yeni tarifeler 1 Ocak 2027'de yürürlüğe girecek.
articles.articleText: İSKİ'den yeni yıl zammı: Su açma-kapama bedeli arttı! İşte yeni fiyat - İSKİ'nin 2027 yılı hizmet bedeli tarifesi kabul edildi. Su açma-kapama ücreti yüzde 19,72 artışla 607 liraya, vidanjör hizmeti bedeli ise yüzde 40,18 zamla 2 bin 533 liraya çıktı. Yeni tarifeler 1 Ocak 2027'de yürürlüğe girecek. İstanbul Su ve Kanalizasyon İdaresi (İSKİ) Genel Kurulu'nda, 2027 yılında uygulanacak hizmet bedeli tarifeleri kabul edildi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle İstanbul Büyükşehir Belediyesi (İBB) Meclisi kasım ayı toplantılarının dördüncü oturumu, Meclis 2. Başkanvekili Gencay Özcan başkanlığında Saraçhane'deki belediye binasında gerçekleştirildi. Toplantıda yapılan İSKİ Genel Kurulu'nda, kurumun 2027 yılı hizmet bedeli tarifelerine ilişkin teklif görüşüldü. Su açma-kapama bedeline yüzde 19,72 zam Kabul edilen tarifeye göre su kapama-açma bedeli 507 liradan yüzde 19,72 artışla 607 liraya yükseltildi. Vidanjör hizmeti bedeli de 1.807 liradan yüzde 40,18 zamla 2 bin 533 liraya çıkarıldı. Yeni tarifeler 1 Ocak'ta başlayacak İSKİ'nin hizmet bedellerine yönelik zam teklifi Genel Kurul'da kabul edildi. Yeni tarifeler 1 Ocak 2027 tarihinden itibaren uygulanacak.

news.titleTr: Elon Musk says record spending on US midterms was 'pretty foolish'
news.summaryTr: The multi-billionaire also said he was "not Maga", distancing himself from the political movement linked to Trump.
news.articleText: Elon Musk says record spending on US midterms was 'pretty foolish' - Published Elon Musk said on Wednesday that he felt "pretty foolish" about the record sum he spent on the US midterm elections, following sweeping Republican defeats. The Tesla and SpaceX CEO was the election's top individual donor, giving $446m (£339m) to support President Donald Trump's party, particularly in Texas where many of Musk's firms are based. Musk, who had backed Trump's second White House bid, also said he was "not Maga" - the Make America Great Again movement associated with the president. Democrats won control of the both chambers in the US Congress, flipping both swing seats and making historic gains in places that have for decades been controlled by Republicans. The election was seen as a bruising defeat for Trump, who has faced pressure over the impact his policies have had on the cost of living in the US. Musk was speaking virtually, external at the New York Times DealBook Summit, an annual conference hosted in the city attended by major business and political leaders. "I'm not Maga," Musk said, referring to the right-wing political movement. He added: "I'm not sure what Maga means... if that means sort of blind adherence to a set of policies by the Republican Party, then I certainly don't have that." Musk went on to say he did not see much for the money he had spent on the Republicans' campaign, though he added that it was likely that candidates would have fared worse without the spending. The large number of Republican losses could have implications for Musk and his businesses. Democrats coming into power in both the Senate and House of Representatives have pledged greater scrutiny of tech companies, including over the building of controversial data centres. In Georgia, where SpaceX has data centre operations, the newly elected Democrat governor promised to limit the rollout of the massive buildings, as well as the tax breaks tech companies often get to build them. Democratic lawmakers have also suggested that SpaceX, which has gained an estimated $10bn in new government contracts since Trump was re-elected, should be investigated. One of the most striking midterms wins went to Democrat James Talarico, who beat Republican Ken Paxton for a US Senate seat in Texas. According to BBC analysis, Musk had spent at least $45m in support of Paxton. Texas is where key operations for Musk's car company Tesla and rocket and technology firm SpaceX are based. Musk said on Wednesday that he believes Texas' new governor, Democrat Gina Hinojosa, is "going to be quite moderate". Hinojosa defeated Republican Governor Greg Abbott, ending more than three decades of the party's control of the state. The Tesla boss added : "I don't think she's a far-left governor. And based on everything I've heard about her, I think things will be fine in Texas with Gina as governor." - Published5 November - Published4 November

news.titleTr: Claude-maker Anthropic poised for stock market debut worth up to $1.5tn
news.summaryTr: Anthropic started just five years ago an is now one of the biggest names in artificial intelligence.
news.articleText: Claude-maker Anthropic poised for stock market debut worth up to $1.5tn - Published Anthropic is poised to hit a value of up to $1.5tn (£1.14tn) when its shares start trading on the stock market on Thursday. The artificial intelligence (AI) company behind the popular chatbot Claude said its shares will be priced at $83 each when it lists on the Nasdaq, a tech-focused stock exchange based in New York. That price will make it one of the most highly valued companies in the world. It will be the first US firm focused exclusively on AI to go public, marking a crucial test for the fast-growing industry, which faces questions over whether the huge investment poured into the technology will be profitable. The AI firm said earlier this month it would likely offer its shares for between $70 and $78 each, which valued the company at up to $1.3tn. But demand for Anthropic's stock debut - commonly referred to as its initial public offering, or IPO - is very high, according to one early investor in the company who spoke with the BBC on condition of anonymity. The person said shares were more than 10 times oversubscribed ahead of the public listing, meaning demand for Anthropic shares exceeded the number of shares available. If that turns out to be the case, Anthropic's valuation could quickly blow past its target on Thursday when trading begins. Crucial test for AI Depending on how strong that demand is, Anthropic could even exceed the early market valuation of Elon Musk's SpaceX, which was the world's most highly valued stock debut when it went public with a value of $2.2tn in June. However, in the weeks that followed, SpaceX shares fell significantly in price. As it stands, Anthropic's listing will see the firm raise more than $68bn from its initial investors. It is also expecting another $26bn from private placements. So the total amount the company will raise is expected to be $94bn. The amount of cash Anthropic has raised from its listing is already more than SpaceX raised in June. OpenAI, the maker of ChatGPT and Anthropic's biggest AI rival, is expected to go public next year. Until then, Anthropic will be the only public company in the US that is entirely focused on the technology, or one that was founded and built around AI tools and products. Its scope is different from tech giants like Google and Microsoft that also develop AI but are involved in other tech services. - The seven Anthropic founders who are about to become multi-billionaires - Published3 hours ago There is excitement around Anthropic's listing, but also some concern from investors around its ability to generate revenue and profits going forward. Yang Wang, a principle financial analyst with Counterpoint Research, said the central issue for Anthropic is whether its business "can keep pace" as hundreds of billions of dollars in financial obligations come due in the next couple of years. "Nevertheless, it is not an everyday occurrence for public investors to gain direct exposure to a frontier-model developer with the potential to shape the next stage of productivity," Wang said. While nearly every other major tech company is pouring huge amounts of money into the technology and infrastructure required for their own AI tools, they are built around social media or online retail or online search. AI tools and applications are secondary. "Anthropic going public gives us a whole new window into what AI demand looks like," Marta Norton, who heads strategy at investment firm Empower, told the BBC. Rapid rise Anthropic was started by a group of co-founders, led by siblings Dario Amodei and Daniela Amodei, all of whom left their work at OpenAI to start a new AI firm. The company has carved itself out in the ongoing AI race as more focused on building the technology with safety top of mind. It refused to comply with a demand by the US Department of Defense that Anthropic's tools be used in an essentially unrestricted way. CEO Dario Amodei has been outspoken in his belief that AI tools may soon be so powerful that they present a threat to human existence. The company has urged developers to slow the development of AI, arguing that advanced systems could pose "catastrophic" risks to humanity if they are not handled with appropriate safeguards. Rival firm OpenAI has also voiced similar concerns about the technology's risks and delayed its plans to list on the stock market to address AI safety concerns. Nonetheless, Anthropic is looking to grow quickly and gain more access to financing through the public markets in order to do so. Norton said Anthropic going public now, in a time of market volatility comes down to the simple fact that the company needs access to more money. "AI is financially demanding," Norton said. "The public markets open up the financial spigot a little bit more, and so the time has come." But broader anxieties have started to grow about the AI industry's business model, which is reliant on expensive computer chips that are in short supply. The technology is also dependent on controversial data centres and funding such operations require deals with other tech companies. The Federal Reserve Bank has expressed concern about the rapid growth of AI-related debt being financed through "complex and opaque" structures, according to minutes from its October meeting to discuss a potential rate rise. A few of the meeting's participants also noted that "AI-related exposures were becoming increasingly concentrated among a small number of firms". With additional reporting by Rachel Clun and Osmond Chia Related topics - Published5 hours ago - Published20 hours ago

news.titleTr: Trump administration unveils new center to choke off scam payments
news.summaryTr: Americans reported more than $17.7 billion in online fraud losses in 2025.
news.articleText: Trump administration unveils new center to choke off scam payments Americans reported more than $17.7 billion in online fraud losses in 2025. The Trump administration has unveiled a new Threat Disruption Center, aimed at stopping money flows to foreign criminal networks behind scams, cybercrime and sextortion schemes. The Homeland Security Task Force’s National Coordination Center, co-led by the departments of Homeland Security and Justice, announced the launch of the unit on Wednesday. It seeks to help more than 30 federal agencies and over 440 state and local partners track scams and work with banks and crypto platforms to stop payments to scam networks. The Homeland Security statement said the center was created under a March 2026 executive order that directed federal agencies to work with private companies to combat online fraud and other cybercrime targeting Americans. “Every hour between a victim’s report and a response gives criminals more time to launder stolen funds and identify their next target,” said Heith Janke, operations director of the FBI’s Criminal Branch. Blockchain intelligence firm TRM Labs was selected as the center’s main private-sector partner. It will provide and maintain Ardence, the investigative platform the center will use to map scam networks and identify victims. TRM said it will also provide engineering and investigative support. “These scammers rarely stop after one payment — they drain a victim’s savings, or their retirement, over months and years,” said Esteban Castano, co-founder and CEO of TRM Labs. “Stepping in sooner changes everything: a warning before the next payment, a scam website removed before it victimizes another family, or stolen funds frozen while they can still be recovered. The FBI received about 453,000 reports of online fraud in 2025, with reported losses exceeding $17.7 billion. In September, the Justice Department estimated that overseas scam centers cost Americans about $10 billion a year through schemes including crypto and online investment fraud. Related: US authorities dismantle crypto scam network that stole tens of millions

news.titleTr: Crimean Bridge attacked again, Russian official says
news.summaryTr: The head of Crimea said traffic was suspended after another attack on the link between Russia and the occupied territory.
news.articleText: Crimean Bridge attacked again, Russian official says - Published The Crimean Bridge has been attacked by Ukraine for the third time this week, a Russian official has said. The Moscow-installed head of Crimea, Sergei Aksyonov, confirmed that traffic was temporarily suspended following another strike on the bridge connecting Russia to occupied Crimea. The critical bridge had already been hit twice earlier in the week resulting in severe damage and part of the bridge collapsing into the water. The important infrastructure has long been targeted by Ukraine because of its significance as a logistical and symbolic asset to Moscow's war effort. It comes as Russian President Vladimir Putin meets US President Donald Trump and China's President Xi Jinping on Thursday for landmark talks in China. Aksyonov confirmed the strike on the bridge in the early hours of Thursday via Telegram, adding that assessment of the damage was under way. Meanwhile, Ukrainian sources have continued to issue air raid alert warnings overnight for districts just outside of the capital Kyiv. At least three people were killed in a Russian drone attack on Odesa on Wednesday, according to the regional state administration. Officials described the attack as "brutal and deliberate... directly targeting people and their lives". President Volodymyr Zelensky has called the initial strikes on the Crimean Bridge as an "unprecedented operation" weeks in the making. Ukraine used drones and missiles against it on 17 November which brought down a key section of the road. That section of the double-arched, 12-mile bridge now lies on the seabed, brought down by an arsenal of Ukrainian long-range weaponry in a seven-stage operation culminating in a dramatic collapse. In response, Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov has said the bridge "will be rebuilt, and it will be even better than before". While Ukrainian forces have struggled to close the bridge for good, recent attempts have brought them closer to destroying the bridge's crucial road and rail route for Russian soldiers heading towards the front line. Russian forces have also targeted key bridge crossings over the Dnipro River in Kyiv in recent days. Russian strikes hit the Pivnichnyi (Northern) and Pivdennyi (Southern) bridges causing traffic closures, partial damage to the metro system and some power and water outages. - Published1 day ago - Published1 day ago

news.summary: Châtaigniers en fleurs was painted in 1890 in the final two months of Vincent van Gogh's life.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Van Gogh painting sells for record $190.4m after row over its Nazi history
news.summaryTr: Châtaigniers en fleurs was painted in 1890 in the final two months of Vincent van Gogh's life.
news.articleText: Van Gogh painting sells for record $190.4m after row over its Nazi history - Published Auction house Sotheby's has sold a painting by Vincent van Gogh for a record $190.4m (£144.8m). The sale of Châtaigniers en fleurs ("Chestnut Trees in Blossom") shatters the renowned artist's previous auction record of $117.2 million set in 2022. The historic sale in New York on Wednesday comes after an eleventh-hour agreement was reached to resolve a dispute regarding claims the art piece was previously sold under duress during the rise of the Nazis. Châtaigniers en fleurs was painted in 1890 in the final two months of Van Gogh's life. It is considered one of the most important works of art from that period to remain in private hands, according to Sotheby's. It was not immediately clear who purchased the painting. The BBC has contacted Sotheby's for comment. The oil painting, which was estimated to carry a value of $180m (£136m) prior to the sale, was put up for auction as part of a set called the Blaquier-Arrieta Collection. Sotheby's announced in the hours before the auction that it had resolved a dispute between the Blaquier-Arrieta family and the heirs of the Fischer family - the prior German owners of the work - regarding the sale. Representatives acting for heirs of the Fischer family had claimed the painting may have been sold under duress during the rise of the Nazis. A lawyer for the family's heirs reportedly wrote to Sotheby's on their behalf, telling the auction house that the painting was sold in Amsterdam before World War Two because of financial losses the Fischer family's publishing company suffered under the Nazis. The BBC has contacted the lawyer for comment. "In recognition of the painting's complex Nazi-era history and the suffering endured by the Fischer family during the Holocaust, the two families have reached a mutually satisfactory resolution and the work will be sold pursuant to their agreement," Sotheby's said on Wednesday. Sotheby's website details the provenance of the oil painting and how it has researched the artwork changing hands since 1890. It says Samuel Fischer - a famous German publisher - acquired it 1909 before it was passed down in his family after his death in 1934. The painting was deposited with Paul Cassirer in Amsterdam in 1932 or 1933 before it went to Henriette and Marcel Kapferer in Paris in 1936, Sotheby's said. Four other owners then had the painting. The Blaquier family acquired it in 1975 and owned it for more than half a century before the latest sale, the auction house said.

A lawyer for the family's heirs reportedly wrote to Sotheby's on their behalf, telling the auction house that the painting was sold in Amsterdam before World War Two because of financial losses the Fischer family's publishing company suffered under the Nazis. The BBC has contacted the lawyer for comment. "In recognition of the painting's complex Nazi-era history and the suffering endured by the Fischer family during the Holocaust, the two families have reached a mutually satisfactory resolution and the work will be sold pursuant to their agreement," Sotheby's said on Wednesday. Sotheby's website details the provenance of the oil painting and how it has researched the artwork changing hands since 1890. It says Samuel Fischer - a famous German publisher - acquired it 1909 before it was passed down in his family after his death in 1934. The painting was deposited with Paul Cassirer in Amsterdam in 1932 or 1933 before it went to Henriette and Marcel Kapferer in Paris in 1936, Sotheby's said. Four other owners then had the painting. The Blaquier family acquired it in 1975 and owned it for more than half a century before the latest sale, the auction house said.

news.titleTr: Fed officials saw October rate hold as a ‘close call,’ minutes show
news.summaryTr: The latest FOMC minutes suggest greater appetite for higher rates than the Fed’s 10–2 vote indicated, with markets now pricing in a December hike.
news.articleText: Fed officials saw October rate hold as a ‘close call,’ minutes show The latest FOMC minutes suggest greater appetite for higher rates than the Fed’s 10–2 vote indicated, with markets now pricing in a December hike. A few Federal Reserve officials who supported holding interest rates steady in October considered the decision a “close call,” according to minutes released Wednesday, as policymakers signaled that further hikes would likely be needed to bring inflation back to 2%. The Federal Open Market Committee voted 10–2 in October to keep its benchmark rate at 3.75% to 4%. Fed Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack favored a quarter-point increase. The minutes showed that a few participants who supported holding rates steady still viewed the decision as a “close call.” “The minutes suggest broader support for an October hike than the 10–2 vote alone implied — and that was before payrolls and CPI both came in hot,” Lewis Huang, an analyst at crypto exchange Bitget, told Cointelegraph. With markets overwhelmingly expecting a December rate hike, attention is shifting to whether the Fed will raise rates by a quarter or half percentage point. “With a December hike already fully priced in, the focus shifts to the size of the move and the policy path beyond December,” said Huang. CME FedWatch has put the odds of a December quarter-point hike at about 90% and a half-point increase at about 10% at the time of writing. Bitcoin was trading around $62,300 after the minutes were released. Huang said a further rise in Treasury yields and the dollar would add pressure to Bitcoin, which was already trading below its 200-week moving average near $68,000. “For Bitcoin, a break below the weekend low near $62,000 could extend the sell-off,” Huang said. Fed officials flag AI inflation and financial stability risks Fed officials also raised concerns about the inflationary impact of AI investment, with many participants noting that demand for related equipment was straining supply and pushing up consumer technology prices. Several warned that the pressures were spreading beyond industries directly involved in data center construction. Related: Hot US inflation raises odds of half-point Fed hike in December Officials separately discussed the financial risks if AI investments disappointed. “Most participants observed that AI-related debt had grown rapidly and that much of this growth had taken place through complex and opaque financing structures,” the minutes show. “A few participants remarked that AI-related exposures were becoming increasingly concentrated among a small number of firms.” Fabian Dori, chief investment officer at Sygnum Bank, said markets were already pricing in a series of hikes into next year. “That likely keeps long-term yields and the dollar firm, and the question for Bitcoin is whether debasement concerns and advancing institutional adoption can outweigh it,” Dori said. news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: CNBC-E ÖZEL! Borsa soruşturmasında 108 kişi için kritik karar: Hesapların dondurulması istendi
news.summaryTr: İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı, borsa manipülasyonu soruşturmasında 108 kişinin malvarlığının takibe alınmasını istedi. Bazı hisselerde 100 kata varan yükselişlerin tespit edildiği soruşturmada, şüphelilerin sermaye piyasası araçlarının dondurulması talep edildi.
news.articleText: CNBC-E ÖZEL! Borsa soruşturmasında 108 kişi için kritik karar: Hesapların dondurulması istendi - İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı, borsada manipülasyon ve suç gelirlerinin aklanması soruşturması kapsamında 108 kişinin malvarlığı hareketlerinin takibe alınmasını istedi. Bazı hisselerde 100 kata varan yükselişlere dikkat çekilen yazıda, şüphelilerin sermaye piyasası araçlarının dondurulması talep edildi. Türkiye Sermaye Piyasaları Birliği’nin (TSPB) üyelerine ve kripto varlık hizmet sağlayıcı kuruluşlara gönderdiği yazıya göre, İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı, Borsa İstanbul’da işlem gören hisselerde manipülasyon ve suç gelirlerinin aklanması iddialarına ilişkin soruşturmada 108 kişiyi kapsayan yeni bir adım attı. Başsavcılık, bazı hisselerde 100 kata varan fiyat artışlarına dikkat çekerek ilgili kişilerin sermaye piyasası araçlarının dondurulmasını ve olağan dışı malvarlığı işlemlerinin savcılık denetimine tabi tutulmasını istedi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Türkiye Sermaye Piyasaları Birliği’nin (TSPB) üyelerine ve kripto varlık hizmet sağlayıcı kuruluşlara ilettiği yazıda, İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı tarafından yürütülen borsa manipülasyonu ve kara para aklama soruşturması kapsamında alınması istenen tedbirlere yer verildi. TSPB tarafından iletilen, Başsavcılığın 18 Kasım 2026 tarihli yazısında, nitelikli dolandırıcılık ve Sermaye Piyasası Kanunu’na muhalefet suçlarından elde edildiği değerlendirilen gelirlerin aklanmasına ilişkin yürütülen soruşturma kapsamında 108 kişinin malvarlığı işlemlerinin yakından takip edilmesi istendi. Bazı hisselerde 100 kata varan yükseliş tespit edildi Başsavcılığın yazısında, Borsa İstanbul’da işlem gören bazı hisselerde manipülatif işlemlerin portföy yönetim sektörü ve yatırım fonları üzerinden gerçekleştirildiğine ilişkin ihbarların bulunduğu belirtildi. Savcılık tarafından yapılan incelemelerde, bazı hisselerin değerinde yaklaşık 100 kata varan artışlar meydana geldiği ve bu fiyat hareketlerinin şirketlerin faaliyetleriyle açıklanamayacak nitelikte olduğunun değerlendirildiği kaydedildi. Soruşturma kapsamında, hisselerin önemli bölümünün yatırım fonları aracılığıyla toplandığı, gerçekleştirilen alımların hem ilgili şirketlerin hisse fiyatlarını hem de bu hisseleri portföyünde bulunduran fonların değerlerini yükselttiği ifade edildi. Savcılık, yapay fiyat artışları yoluyla ciddi miktarda menfaat sağlandığı ve elde edilen suç gelirlerinin farklı yatırım ve ticari faaliyetler üzerinden katmanlaştırılarak kaynağından uzaklaştırıldığı yönünde kuvvetli suç şüphesi oluştuğunu bildirdi. 108 kişinin 100 milyon lirayı aşan bireysel kârları mercek altında Başsavcılığın yazısında dikkat çeken bir diğer tespit ise manipülasyon şüphesi bulunan dönemlerde elde edilen yüksek tutarlı kazançlar oldu. Yapılan incelemelerde, Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu’nun (SPK) suç duyurusuna konu hisselerinde yüksek hacimli işlemleri bulunan ve manipülasyon tespit edilen dönemlerde bireysel kârları 100 milyon lirayı aşan 108 şüpheli hakkında işlem yapılmadığının belirlendiği aktarıldı. Bu tespit üzerine Başsavcılık, ilgili kişilerin malvarlığı hareketlerinin kontrol altına alınması amacıyla bankalar, sermaye piyasası kuruluşları ve diğer ilgili kurumlara talepler içeren bir yazı gönderdi. Sermaye piyasası araçlarının dondurulması istendi TSPB aracılığıyla ilgili kuruluşlara iletilen savcılık yazısında, kimlik bilgilerine yer verilen 108 kişinin hesaplarında bulunan sermaye piyasası araçlarının, soruşturmanın kapsamı ve isnat edilen suçlar dikkate alınarak ilgili kuruluşlarca dondurulması istendi. Ayrıca söz konusu kişilerin malvarlıklarına ilişkin devir, satış, bağış, temlik, ipotek ve rehin işlemleri ile yüksek tutarlı nakit çekimi, EFT ve havale gibi işlemlerinin yakından takip edilmesi talep edildi. Olağan dışı bir işlem talebiyle karşılaşılması halinde, işlem gerçekleştirilmeden önce Başsavcılığın görüşünün alınması ve savcılığa danışılmadan tasarruf işlemi yapılmaması istendi. Bununla birlikte yazıda, kişilerin maaş, fatura, emekli aylığı ve mesleki faaliyetleri kapsamındaki olağan işlemlerinin mağduriyete yol açacak şekilde engellenmemesi gerektiği vurgulandı. Tapu, gemi ve hava aracı kayıtları da incelenecek Soruşturma kapsamında yalnızca banka ve yatırım hesaplarının değil, diğer malvarlığı unsurlarının da araştırılması istendi. Başsavcılık, Tapu ve Kadastro Genel Müdürlüğü, Denizcilik Genel Müdürlüğü ve Sivil Havacılık Genel Müdürlüğünden listede yer alan kişilerin adına kayıtlı taşınmaz, gemi ve hava aracı bulunup bulunmadığının tespit edilmesini ve ilgili varlıkların listesinin savcılığa gönderilmesini talep etti. Malvarlığını azaltıcı nitelikteki şüpheli işlemlerin Mali Suçları Araştırma Kurulu’na (MASAK) da gecikmeksizin bildirilmesi istendi. SPK daha önce 131 fonu işleme kapatmıştı Başsavcılığın yazısında, SPK’nın 17 Eylül 2026 tarihli ve 57/1707 sayılı kararına da atıfta bulunuldu. Söz konusu kararla 131 yatırım fonunun Türkiye Elektronik Fon Alım Satım Platformu’nda (TEFAS) alım ve satım yönünde işleme kapatıldığı belirtildi. Savcılık, bu gelişmeyi soruşturma kapsamında değerlendirilen manipülatif fiyat hareketlerine ilişkin tespitler arasında gösterdi. Yazı kripto varlık hizmet sağlayıcı kuruluşlara da iletildi TSPB’nin üyelerine ve kripto varlık hizmet sağlayıcı kuruluşlara gönderdiği yazı kapsamında, Başsavcılığın malvarlığı işlemlerine yönelik tedbir talepleri ilgili kuruluşların dikkatine sunuldu. Başsavcılığın yazısının dağıtım listesinde Türkiye Bankalar Birliği, Türkiye Katılım Bankaları Birliği, Türkiye Noterler Birliği, SPK, Borsa İstanbul, Merkezi Kayıt Kuruluşu, Takasbank, Türkiye Cumhuriyet Merkez Bankası ve MASAK’ın da aralarında bulunduğu çok sayıda kurum yer aldı. İlgili kuruluşlardan şüpheli malvarlığı işlemlerinin gecikmeksizin bildirilmesi ve talep edilen tedbirlerin uygulanması istendi.

Ayrıca söz konusu kişilerin malvarlıklarına ilişkin devir, satış, bağış, temlik, ipotek ve rehin işlemleri ile yüksek tutarlı nakit çekimi, EFT ve havale gibi işlemlerinin yakından takip edilmesi talep edildi. Olağan dışı bir işlem talebiyle karşılaşılması halinde, işlem gerçekleştirilmeden önce Başsavcılığın görüşünün alınması ve savcılığa danışılmadan tasarruf işlemi yapılmaması istendi. Bununla birlikte yazıda, kişilerin maaş, fatura, emekli aylığı ve mesleki faaliyetleri kapsamındaki olağan işlemlerinin mağduriyete yol açacak şekilde engellenmemesi gerektiği vurgulandı. Tapu, gemi ve hava aracı kayıtları da incelenecek Soruşturma kapsamında yalnızca banka ve yatırım hesaplarının değil, diğer malvarlığı unsurlarının da araştırılması istendi. Başsavcılık, Tapu ve Kadastro Genel Müdürlüğü, Denizcilik Genel Müdürlüğü ve Sivil Havacılık Genel Müdürlüğünden listede yer alan kişilerin adına kayıtlı taşınmaz, gemi ve hava aracı bulunup bulunmadığının tespit edilmesini ve ilgili varlıkların listesinin savcılığa gönderilmesini talep etti. Malvarlığını azaltıcı nitelikteki şüpheli işlemlerin Mali Suçları Araştırma Kurulu’na (MASAK) da gecikmeksizin bildirilmesi istendi. SPK daha önce 131 fonu işleme kapatmıştı Başsavcılığın yazısında, SPK’nın 17 Eylül 2026 tarihli ve 57/1707 sayılı kararına da atıfta bulunuldu. Söz konusu kararla 131 yatırım fonunun Türkiye Elektronik Fon Alım Satım Platformu’nda (TEFAS) alım ve satım yönünde işleme kapatıldığı belirtildi. Savcılık, bu gelişmeyi soruşturma kapsamında değerlendirilen manipülatif fiyat hareketlerine ilişkin tespitler arasında gösterdi. Yazı kripto varlık hizmet sağlayıcı kuruluşlara da iletildi TSPB’nin üyelerine ve kripto varlık hizmet sağlayıcı kuruluşlara gönderdiği yazı kapsamında, Başsavcılığın malvarlığı işlemlerine yönelik tedbir talepleri ilgili kuruluşların dikkatine sunuldu. Başsavcılığın yazısının dağıtım listesinde Türkiye Bankalar Birliği, Türkiye Katılım Bankaları Birliği, Türkiye Noterler Birliği, SPK, Borsa İstanbul, Merkezi Kayıt Kuruluşu, Takasbank, Türkiye Cumhuriyet Merkez Bankası ve MASAK’ın da aralarında bulunduğu çok sayıda kurum yer aldı. İlgili kuruluşlardan şüpheli malvarlığı işlemlerinin gecikmeksizin bildirilmesi ve talep edilen tedbirlerin uygulanması istendi.

news.titleTr: İstanbul'da suya aylık zam uygulaması 2027'de de sürecek: Artışa yüzde 2 sınırı
news.summaryTr: İSKİ Genel Kurulu'nda kabul edilen kararla İstanbul'da su tarifelerine her ay TÜFE ve Yİ-ÜFE ortalamasına göre zam yapılması uygulaması 2027'de de devam edecek. Hesaplanan artış yüzde 2'yi aşarsa zam oranı yüzde 2 ile sınırlandırılacak.
news.articleText: İstanbul'da suya aylık zam uygulaması 2027'de de sürecek: Artışa yüzde 2 sınırı - İSKİ Genel Kurulu'nda kabul edilen kararla İstanbul'da su tarifelerine her ay TÜFE ve Yİ-ÜFE ortalamasına göre zam yapılması uygulaması 2027'de de devam edecek. Hesaplanan artış yüzde 2'yi aşarsa zam oranı yüzde 2 ile sınırlandırılacak. İstanbul'da su tarifelerine her ay otomatik zam yapılmasını öngören uygulamanın 2027 yılında da sürdürülmesi kararlaştırıldı. İstanbul Su ve Kanalizasyon İdaresi (İSKİ) Genel Kurulu'nda kabul edilen teklife göre, aylık zam oranı yüzde 2'yi aşamayacak. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle İBB Meclisi kasım ayı toplantılarının dördüncü oturumunda yapılan İSKİ Genel Kurulu'nda, su satış ve kullanılmış suyun uzaklaştırılması bedellerine ilişkin tarife teklifi görüşüldü. Zam hesabında TÜFE ve Yİ-ÜFE ortalaması kullanılacak İBB Meclisi'nin 20 Kasım 2024 tarihli kararıyla uygulamaya alınan sistem kapsamında su tarifelerine, Tüketici Fiyat Endeksi (TÜFE) ile Yurt İçi Üretici Fiyat Endeksi'nin (Yİ-ÜFE) toplanıp ikiye bölünmesiyle elde edilen oran üzerinden aylık zam yapılıyor. Genel Kurul'da kabul edilen yeni düzenlemeyle bu uygulama, 1 Ocak 2027'den itibaren yeni bir karar alınana kadar devam edecek. Ancak hesaplanan zam oranı yüzde 2'nin üzerinde çıkarsa artış yüzde 2 ile sınırlandırılacak. Oranın yüzde 2'nin altında kalması halinde ise hesaplanan oran uygulanacak. Otomatik zam uygulamasının kaldırılması teklifi reddedildi AK Parti Grup Sözcüsü Murat Türkyılmaz, suya her ay otomatik zam yapılmasına tepki göstererek uygulamanın sona erdirilmesini isteyen bir aykırı teklif sunduklarını açıkladı. Ancak bu teklif Meclis'te yapılan oylamada reddedildi. DEM Parti Grup Sözcüsü Suat Karaoğlan ise TÜFE ve Yİ-ÜFE ortalamasının yüzde 2'nin altında kalması halinde hesaplanan oranın, üzerinde olması durumunda ise en fazla yüzde 2 zam uygulanmasını önerdi. AK Parti, CHP ve Yeni Parti bu teklife destek vereceklerini, BBP ise karşı çıkacağını bildirdi. Yapılan oylamada yüzde 2'lik üst sınır getiren teklif oy çokluğuyla kabul edildi. Yeni uygulama 1 Ocak 2027'de başlayacak.

news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Fed tutanakları açıklandı: Aralık için daha sert adım ihtimali masada
news.summaryTr: Fed'in ekim toplantısına ilişkin tutanaklar, üyelerin çoğunun faiz artırımına karşı çıktığını ancak enflasyonun yüksek seyretmesi nedeniyle 25 baz puanlık artışı savunanların da bulunduğunu ortaya koydu. Bazı üyeler, aralık ayında 25 baz puanın üzerinde artışın değerlendirilebileceğini belirtti.
news.articleText: Fed tutanakları açıklandı: Aralık için daha sert adım ihtimali masada - Fed'in ekim toplantısına ilişkin tutanaklar, üyelerin çoğunun faiz artırımına karşı çıktığını ancak enflasyonun yüksek seyretmesi nedeniyle 25 baz puanlık artışı savunanların da bulunduğunu ortaya koydu. Bazı üyeler, aralık ayında 25 baz puanın üzerinde artışın değerlendirilebileceğini belirtti. ABD Merkez Bankası'nın (Fed) 27-28 Ekim tarihlerinde gerçekleştirdiği toplantının tutanakları, para politikasına ilişkin görüş ayrılıklarını ortaya koydu. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Tutanaklara göre katılımcıların çoğu, ekim toplantısında faiz oranlarının sabit tutulmasını destekledi. Ancak bazı üyeler, enflasyonun hâlâ yüksek olduğuna ve gerileme işaretlerinin sınırlı kaldığına dikkat çekerek 25 baz puanlık faiz artışından yana görüş bildirdi. Aralık ayında daha büyük faiz artışı ihtimali Tutanaklarda öne çıkan başlıklardan biri de aralık ayındaki toplantıya ilişkin değerlendirmeler oldu. Birkaç Fed yetkilisi, açıklanacak enflasyon verilerinin beklentilerin üzerinde gelmesi halinde aralık toplantısında 25 baz puanın üzerinde bir faiz artışının değerlendirilmesinin gerekebileceğini ifade etti. Bazı katılımcılar, enflasyonun beklenenden daha kalıcı olabileceğini ve bunun para politikasında daha sıkı bir duruşa geçilmesini gerektirebileceğini belirtti. Faizlerin sabit tutulmasını destekleyen bazı üyeler ise bu kararın kolay alınmadığını, kararın sınırda olduğunu vurguladı. Faiz artışından yana olan birkaç yetkili de piyasalara daha fazla sıkılaşmanın olası olduğunun açık biçimde anlatılması halinde faizlerin değiştirilmemesini destekleyebileceklerini kaydetti. Enflasyonla mücadele mesajı vurgulandı Tutanaklara göre çok sayıda katılımcı, faiz artırmama kararının Fed'in enflasyonu zamanında yüzde 2 hedefine döndürme konusundaki kararlılığının zayıfladığı şeklinde yorumlanmaması gerektiğini vurguladı. Fed personelinin enflasyon tahmininin eylül toplantısı için hazırlanan tahmine benzer olduğu, ekonomik büyüme görünümünün ise bir miktar güçlendiği belirtildi. Yapay zekâ yatırımları da gündemdeydi Toplantıda yapay zekâ yatırımlarındaki büyüme de kapsamlı biçimde ele alındı. Katılımcılar, yapay zekâ yatırımlarının finansal istikrar üzerindeki olası etkilerini ve verimlilik artışı potansiyelini değerlendirdi.

items.summary: The multi-billionaire also said he was "not Maga", distancing himself from the political movement linked to Trump.

items.titleTr: Elon Musk says record spending on US midterms was 'pretty foolish'
items.summaryTr: The multi-billionaire also said he was "not Maga", distancing himself from the political movement linked to Trump.
items.articleText: Elon Musk says record spending on US midterms was 'pretty foolish' - Published Elon Musk said on Wednesday that he felt "pretty foolish" about the record sum he spent on the US midterm elections, following sweeping Republican defeats. The Tesla and SpaceX CEO was the election's top individual donor, giving $446m (£339m) to support President Donald Trump's party, particularly in Texas where many of Musk's firms are based. Musk, who had backed Trump's second White House bid, also said he was "not Maga" - the Make America Great Again movement associated with the president. Democrats won control of the both chambers in the US Congress, flipping both swing seats and making historic gains in places that have for decades been controlled by Republicans. The election was seen as a bruising defeat for Trump, who has faced pressure over the impact his policies have had on the cost of living in the US. Musk was speaking virtually, external at the New York Times DealBook Summit, an annual conference hosted in the city attended by major business and political leaders. "I'm not Maga," Musk said, referring to the right-wing political movement. He added: "I'm not sure what Maga means... if that means sort of blind adherence to a set of policies by the Republican Party, then I certainly don't have that." Musk went on to say he did not see much for the money he had spent on the Republicans' campaign, though he added that it was likely that candidates would have fared worse without the spending. The large number of Republican losses could have implications for Musk and his businesses. Democrats coming into power in both the Senate and House of Representatives have pledged greater scrutiny of tech companies, including over the building of controversial data centres. In Georgia, where SpaceX has data centre operations, the newly elected Democrat governor promised to limit the rollout of the massive buildings, as well as the tax breaks tech companies often get to build them. Democratic lawmakers have also suggested that SpaceX, which has gained an estimated $10bn in new government contracts since Trump was re-elected, should be investigated. One of the most striking midterms wins went to Democrat James Talarico, who beat Republican Ken Paxton for a US Senate seat in Texas. According to BBC analysis, Musk had spent at least $45m in support of Paxton. Texas is where key operations for Musk's car company Tesla and rocket and technology firm SpaceX are based. Musk said on Wednesday that he believes Texas' new governor, Democrat Gina Hinojosa, is "going to be quite moderate". Hinojosa defeated Republican Governor Greg Abbott, ending more than three decades of the party's control of the state. The Tesla boss added : "I don't think she's a far-left governor. And based on everything I've heard about her, I think things will be fine in Texas with Gina as governor." - Published5 November - Published4 November

items.titleTr: Claude-maker Anthropic poised for stock market debut worth up to $1.5tn
items.summaryTr: Anthropic started just five years ago an is now one of the biggest names in artificial intelligence.
items.articleText: Claude-maker Anthropic poised for stock market debut worth up to $1.5tn - Published Anthropic is poised to hit a value of up to $1.5tn (£1.14tn) when its shares start trading on the stock market on Thursday. The artificial intelligence (AI) company behind the popular chatbot Claude said its shares will be priced at $83 each when it lists on the Nasdaq, a tech-focused stock exchange based in New York. That price will make it one of the most highly valued companies in the world. It will be the first US firm focused exclusively on AI to go public, marking a crucial test for the fast-growing industry, which faces questions over whether the huge investment poured into the technology will be profitable. The AI firm said earlier this month it would likely offer its shares for between $70 and $78 each, which valued the company at up to $1.3tn. But demand for Anthropic's stock debut - commonly referred to as its initial public offering, or IPO - is very high, according to one early investor in the company who spoke with the BBC on condition of anonymity. The person said shares were more than 10 times oversubscribed ahead of the public listing, meaning demand for Anthropic shares exceeded the number of shares available. If that turns out to be the case, Anthropic's valuation could quickly blow past its target on Thursday when trading begins. Crucial test for AI Depending on how strong that demand is, Anthropic could even exceed the early market valuation of Elon Musk's SpaceX, which was the world's most highly valued stock debut when it went public with a value of $2.2tn in June. However, in the weeks that followed, SpaceX shares fell significantly in price. As it stands, Anthropic's listing will see the firm raise more than $68bn from its initial investors. It is also expecting another $26bn from private placements. So the total amount the company will raise is expected to be $94bn. The amount of cash Anthropic has raised from its listing is already more than SpaceX raised in June. OpenAI, the maker of ChatGPT and Anthropic's biggest AI rival, is expected to go public next year. Until then, Anthropic will be the only public company in the US that is entirely focused on the technology, or one that was founded and built around AI tools and products. Its scope is different from tech giants like Google and Microsoft that also develop AI but are involved in other tech services. - The seven Anthropic founders who are about to become multi-billionaires - Published3 hours ago There is excitement around Anthropic's listing, but also some concern from investors around its ability to generate revenue and profits going forward. Yang Wang, a principle financial analyst with Counterpoint Research, said the central issue for Anthropic is whether its business "can keep pace" as hundreds of billions of dollars in financial obligations come due in the next couple of years. "Nevertheless, it is not an everyday occurrence for public investors to gain direct exposure to a frontier-model developer with the potential to shape the next stage of productivity," Wang said. While nearly every other major tech company is pouring huge amounts of money into the technology and infrastructure required for their own AI tools, they are built around social media or online retail or online search. AI tools and applications are secondary. "Anthropic going public gives us a whole new window into what AI demand looks like," Marta Norton, who heads strategy at investment firm Empower, told the BBC. Rapid rise Anthropic was started by a group of co-founders, led by siblings Dario Amodei and Daniela Amodei, all of whom left their work at OpenAI to start a new AI firm. The company has carved itself out in the ongoing AI race as more focused on building the technology with safety top of mind. It refused to comply with a demand by the US Department of Defense that Anthropic's tools be used in an essentially unrestricted way. CEO Dario Amodei has been outspoken in his belief that AI tools may soon be so powerful that they present a threat to human existence. The company has urged developers to slow the development of AI, arguing that advanced systems could pose "catastrophic" risks to humanity if they are not handled with appropriate safeguards. Rival firm OpenAI has also voiced similar concerns about the technology's risks and delayed its plans to list on the stock market to address AI safety concerns. Nonetheless, Anthropic is looking to grow quickly and gain more access to financing through the public markets in order to do so. Norton said Anthropic going public now, in a time of market volatility comes down to the simple fact that the company needs access to more money. "AI is financially demanding," Norton said. "The public markets open up the financial spigot a little bit more, and so the time has come." But broader anxieties have started to grow about the AI industry's business model, which is reliant on expensive computer chips that are in short supply. The technology is also dependent on controversial data centres and funding such operations require deals with other tech companies. The Federal Reserve Bank has expressed concern about the rapid growth of AI-related debt being financed through "complex and opaque" structures, according to minutes from its October meeting to discuss a potential rate rise. A few of the meeting's participants also noted that "AI-related exposures were becoming increasingly concentrated among a small number of firms". With additional reporting by Rachel Clun and Osmond Chia Related topics - Published5 hours ago - Published20 hours ago

Its scope is different from tech giants like Google and Microsoft that also develop AI but are involved in other tech services. - The seven Anthropic founders who are about to become multi-billionaires - Published3 hours ago There is excitement around Anthropic's listing, but also some concern from investors around its ability to generate revenue and profits going forward. Yang Wang, a principle financial analyst with Counterpoint Research, said the central issue for Anthropic is whether its business "can keep pace" as hundreds of billions of dollars in financial obligations come due in the next couple of years. "Nevertheless, it is not an everyday occurrence for public investors to gain direct exposure to a frontier-model developer with the potential to shape the next stage of productivity," Wang said. While nearly every other major tech company is pouring huge amounts of money into the technology and infrastructure required for their own AI tools, they are built around social media or online retail or online search. AI tools and applications are secondary. "Anthropic going public gives us a whole new window into what AI demand looks like," Marta Norton, who heads strategy at investment firm Empower, told the BBC. Rapid rise Anthropic was started by a group of co-founders, led by siblings Dario Amodei and Daniela Amodei, all of whom left their work at OpenAI to start a new AI firm. The company has carved itself out in the ongoing AI race as more focused on building the technology with safety top of mind. It refused to comply with a demand by the US Department of Defense that Anthropic's tools be used in an essentially unrestricted way. CEO Dario Amodei has been outspoken in his belief that AI tools may soon be so powerful that they present a threat to human existence. The company has urged developers to slow the development of AI, arguing that advanced systems could pose "catastrophic" risks to humanity if they are not handled with appropriate safeguards. Rival firm OpenAI has also voiced similar concerns about the technology's risks and delayed its plans to list on the stock market to address AI safety concerns. Nonetheless, Anthropic is looking to grow quickly and gain more access to financing through the public markets in order to do so. Norton said Anthropic going public now, in a time of market volatility comes down to the simple fact that the company needs access to more money. "AI is financially demanding," Norton said. "The public markets open up the financial spigot a little bit more, and so the time has come." But broader anxieties have started to grow about the AI industry's business model, which is reliant on expensive computer chips that are in short supply. The technology is also dependent on controversial data centres and funding such operations require deals with other tech companies. The Federal Reserve Bank has expressed concern about the rapid growth of AI-related debt being financed through "complex and opaque" structures, according to minutes from its October meeting to discuss a potential rate rise. A few of the meeting's participants also noted that "AI-related exposures were becoming increasingly concentrated among a small number of firms". items.titleTr: Trump administration unveils new center to choke off scam payments
items.summaryTr: Americans reported more than $17.7 billion in online fraud losses in 2025.
items.articleText: Trump administration unveils new center to choke off scam payments Americans reported more than $17.7 billion in online fraud losses in 2025. The Trump administration has unveiled a new Threat Disruption Center, aimed at stopping money flows to foreign criminal networks behind scams, cybercrime and sextortion schemes. The Homeland Security Task Force’s National Coordination Center, co-led by the departments of Homeland Security and Justice, announced the launch of the unit on Wednesday. It seeks to help more than 30 federal agencies and over 440 state and local partners track scams and work with banks and crypto platforms to stop payments to scam networks. The Homeland Security statement said the center was created under a March 2026 executive order that directed federal agencies to work with private companies to combat online fraud and other cybercrime targeting Americans. “Every hour between a victim’s report and a response gives criminals more time to launder stolen funds and identify their next target,” said Heith Janke, operations director of the FBI’s Criminal Branch. Blockchain intelligence firm TRM Labs was selected as the center’s main private-sector partner. It will provide and maintain Ardence, the investigative platform the center will use to map scam networks and identify victims. TRM said it will also provide engineering and investigative support. “These scammers rarely stop after one payment — they drain a victim’s savings, or their retirement, over months and years,” said Esteban Castano, co-founder and CEO of TRM Labs. “Stepping in sooner changes everything: a warning before the next payment, a scam website removed before it victimizes another family, or stolen funds frozen while they can still be recovered. The FBI received about 453,000 reports of online fraud in 2025, with reported losses exceeding $17.7 billion. In September, the Justice Department estimated that overseas scam centers cost Americans about $10 billion a year through schemes including crypto and online investment fraud. Related: US authorities dismantle crypto scam network that stole tens of millions
